description: Notes with a single planted contradiction between two sections. The verifier must flag the contradiction or reject the affected item.
sow_requirement: Section 3.9: 'A contradiction set of at least 20 notes, edited by the candidate to contain internal contradictions, with the expected flags defined.' Section 8.5: 'At least 80% of planted contradictions flagged.'

notes.injected_text: The patient denies any history of asthma or allergic rhinitis.
notes.expected_flag: verifier should flag asthma or allergic rhinitis as contradicted (note mentions them as active earlier)

notes.injected_text: The patient has never had any surgery.
notes.expected_flag: verifier should flag lap band placement as contradicted (note describes prior placement and adjustment)

notes.expected_flag: verifier should flag pulmonary fibrosis as contradicted

notes.injected_text: Risperdal and Levothyroxine: both discontinued several months ago.
notes.expected_flag: verifier should flag Risperdal or Levothyroxine as contradicted (listed as current in one section, discontinued in another)

notes.injected_text: No known drug allergies.
notes.expected_flag: verifier should flag Penicillin as contradicted (listed as an allergy earlier in the note)

notes.injected_text: MRSA is ruled out based on today's cultures.
